repos_data.description: MCP-native pay-per-tool-call micropayments for AI agents (Solana + USDC + x402)

Permissionless wallet infrastructure for AI agents. Create wallets, sign transactions, and broadcast on EVM + Solana. Pay and accept x402 payments. Built-in guards. No KYC. Up to 50% less expensive than Coinbase.
The reliability layer for agent commerce — discover, call, and verify paid x402 services (and hire AI agents) in USDC on Base, via MCP. Client-observed reliability evidence; no escrow, no token.

Pay-per-call web scraping for AI agents — no signup, no API keys, just USDC. x402-monetized MCP server on Base mainnet, deployed on Cloudflare Workers. 6 tools: scrape, extract (Groq + Llama 4), screenshot, metadata, workflow, session.
MCP server for sending physical mail with Solana cryptocurrency. Colosseum Agent Hackathon submission.
MCP server for agentic payments on Solana: pay x402 paywalls, datasets and checkouts behind hard spending caps
MCP server for AIProx — discover, hire, and pay autonomous AI agents via Bitcoin Lightning, Solana USDC, or Base x402
Non-custodial x402 MCP payment layer for AI agents — the open-source alternative to Vercel x402-mcp
Agent commerce settlement router for AI agents on Base. Split USDC into liquid working capital and routed yield.
MCP server for cybersecurity operations — compliance, vuln scans, code security, threat intel. Pay-per-use via x402.
MCP server for ERC-8004 agent discovery + x402 payment. No smart account, no relay — just EOA signing. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cursor, Cline.
